description_en: Invokes this API operation to query the list of sound code labels that failed to be created in a specified sound code label batch
description_zh: 调用该接口查询指定声码标签批次下创建失败的声码标签列表
name: QuerySoundCodeLabelBatchFailedResult

parameters.description_en:
The instance ID.<props="china"><ph>You can view the **ID** of your current instance on the **Instance Overview** page in the IoT Platform console.</ph></props>

><notice>
- If your instance has an ID, you must specify this parameter. Otherwise, the invocation fails.
- If your instance does not have an ID, you do not need to specify this parameter.

></notice>

<props="china">For more information about instances, see [How to obtain an instance ID](~~267533~~).</props>

实例ID。<props="china"><ph>您可在物联网平台控制台的**实例概览**页面，查看当前实例的**ID**。</ph></props>

><notice>
- 若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。
- 若无ID值，则无需传入。

></notice>
